## Activity

During March 2022, East City Eye Clinic completed 187 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the reporting month. The results provide a summary of imaging undertaken at the site and form the basis for the image quality and grading measures set out below. The clinic should continue to record activity consistently so that any changes in service delivery can be identified through routine monitoring.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable image sets. The ungradable rate was 1.6 per cent. This measure should be reviewed alongside local operational information, including any recurring camera issues that may affect image acquisition. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help maintain the quality of imaging provided.

## Grading

A total of 35 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 18. This measure should be considered with the activity and image quality results when reviewing the site’s performance for March 2022. East City Eye Clinic should continue to monitor grading outcomes and ensure that operational issues affecting the process are recorded through the appropriate service channels.
